description: Team Lunar Legacy is a full student team from SMK Merbau joining the Miri 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge for the Abandoned but not Forgotten storytelling challenge. We will produce a short storyboard‑style voice‑over video to share the legacy of discarded NASA equipment left on the Moon. Our skills include script‑writing, storyboard illustration, graphic design, videography and CapCut video editing.
summary: Our project Lunar Legacy 2026 is a 27‑second heartfelt animated short‑film created for the “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” challenge. We follow Luna, a young space‑loving girl, who meets Robot Apollo, a lonely lunar rover left behind once his mission ended. Luna promises to remember Apollo and all forgotten space relics, honouring the legacy of abandoned lunar hardware. This story addresses the challenge by introducing young space enthusiasts to neglected space‑exploration equipment, teaching kindness and remembrance for NASA’s lunar missions. We used NASA’s Moon Exploration Program as our reference, paired with original character design, script writing, voice‑over planning and CapCut video editing to deliver an emotional, easy‑to‑understand message for younger audiences.
details: Lunar Legacy 2026 is a 27‑second animated short‑film for the “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” challenge. It follows Luna, a young space‑loving girl, as she meets Robot Apollo – an abandoned lunar rover. Luna promises to remember Apollo and all forgotten space relics, honouring the legacy of NASA’s space hardware. Our goal is to inspire young space enthusiasts to learn about abandoned space missions through a warm, heartfelt story. We used AI‑assisted script writing & image generation, CapCut for video editing, voice‑over, and gentle background music. Our team designed original characters and timed every scene carefully to keep the emotional impact strong within the short runtime.
